revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, replacement for local candidate achievement_medal_steps_tier_009, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_009
Primary request: Regenerate tier 9, PURPLE rank, FIRST medal in the purple pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "不知道您是否听说过一个叫骆驼祥子的人？" (a nod to a tireless rickshaw-pulling walker). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels. This replacement must stay clearly purple after background removal.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #00ff00 color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 9 pose: the foot mascot is comically pulling a tiny empty old-fashioned handcart/rickshaw handle, leaning forward with heroic effort and a theatrical tired grin. The cart is a small prop with no text, no brand, no people.
Medal border: PURPLE rank, FIRST purple medal. Use strong violet and amethyst enamel circular ring with silver trim, small purple gems, small studs, and modest purple ornaments attached to the ring. IMPORTANT: no side wings, no feather wings, no large outward leaf wings, no big side fins. The silhouette must remain mostly circular with only small protrusions.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core. Base circle size consistent with previous tiers.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, dramatic and funny.
Color palette: clearly violet and amethyst purple border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, muted brown tiny cart; avoid #00ff00 anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no wings, no feather wings, no external side wings, no large outward fins, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: first medal in color pair has no wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #00ff00 chroma key for purple candidate, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
